name: Template: direct health (deaths and illness averted)
summary: TEMPLATE: what the charity does, where, the bottom line in years of healthy life per $1,000 (quote it live in the write-up), and the biggest uncertainty.

sections.title: Cost
sections.explainer: What the modelled program cost in the period the outcomes below are counted for, including its share of overhead. From audited financial statements or the annual report.

sections.title: Reach
sections.explainer: How many people, animals or meals the spending reached, as the charity reports it.

sections.title: Effect per unit
sections.explainer: What the intervention does for each unit reached, from the best available studies, before any adjustment.

sections.title: Adjustments
sections.explainer: Discounts for weaker evidence, what would have happened anyway, credit shared with others, and delivery falling short. All multiply the outcome.

sections.title: Outcome
sections.explainer: The outcome in the family's shared unit, per dollar.

sections.title: Your dollar's share
sections.explainer: Staff who earn less than they could elsewhere pay part of the cost in kind. With credit by share of resources, your dollar is credited with its share of the full cost only.

rows.label: Spending on the modelled program(s) in the period
rows.explainer: TEMPLATE: program expenses for the activities modelled below, for the same year as the reach numbers. Cite the audited statement of functional expenses (or the annual report) and the page.

rows.label: Total expenses (all programs, management, fundraising)
rows.explainer: TEMPLATE: total expenses for the same year, from the same document.

rows.label: Program expenses (all programs)
rows.explainer: TEMPLATE: program-service expenses for the same year, from the same document.

rows.label: Overhead multiplier (total ÷ program expenses)
rows.explainer: Spreads management and fundraising over programs in proportion to their cost, as GiveWell and ACE do.

rows.label: Cost of the modelled program, including overhead
People reached in the period

source.title: TEMPLATE: charity annual report / coverage survey

rows.explainer: TEMPLATE: people who received the intervention in the year the spending covers (children dosed, people sleeping under nets distributed, infants vaccinated). Prefer independent coverage surveys to administrative counts; note which.

rows.label: Cost per person reached
rows.explainer: Context: compare with the charity's own figure and with other models of the family.

rows.label: Years of protection per person reached
rows.explainer: TEMPLATE: how long one round of the intervention protects a person (e.g. one dose, one net's useful life × usage).

rows.label: Annual mortality the intervention can reduce, in the target group
rows.explainer: TEMPLATE: deaths per person-year from the causes the intervention affects, in the target age group and region, without the program. Use (or add) a country fact in facts/<country>.json (IHME GBD, UN IGME, DHS).

rows.label: Reduction in that mortality from the intervention
rows.explainer: TEMPLATE: relative risk reduction from the best meta-analysis (Cochrane or equivalent); the 95% CI as low/high.

rows.label: Deaths averted per person reached (before adjustments)
rows.explainer: If the intervention protects several age groups with different risks, replace this formula with one row per group and sum them here.

rows.label: Share of deaths averted that are of children under five
rows.explainer: TEMPLATE: the age split of the deaths averted, from the age split of cause-specific deaths in the target group.

rows.label: Value of illness averted, as a share of the value of deaths averted

source.title: TEMPLATE: IHME GBD disability weights / GiveWell

rows.explainer: TEMPLATE: illness averted (GBD disability weights × cases averted × duration) valued against the deaths averted, as GiveWell's supplementary adjustments do. A share, not DALYs × an exchange rate: no rate between outcomes may sit inside a model (docs/normalization.md INV-2). 0 with an explanation when illness is covered by unmodelled_benefits_adj instead; never both.

rows.label: Later-life income gain per person reached, ln(consumption) per year
rows.explainer: TEMPLATE: the yearly increase in ln(consumption) in adulthood from developmental effects (e.g. malaria or deworming and adult earnings), per person reached, undiscounted. 0 with an explanation when there is no evidence.

rows.label: Years until the income gain starts
rows.explainer: TEMPLATE: years from the intervention to adult earnings (GiveWell uses about 10 for child-health programs).

rows.label: Years the income gain lasts
rows.explainer: TEMPLATE: working years over which the gain lasts (GiveWell uses 40).

rows.label: Later-life income gain per person reached, present value
rows.explainer: Discounted at the shared rate, so the result moves with it. Never type in a present value worked out elsewhere: rebuild it from its inputs.

rows.label: Evidence adjustment (internal and external validity)
rows.explainer: TEMPLATE: how far the effect size above should be trusted for this charity's setting: publication bias, self-report bias, replication, differences between study populations and this program. 1 = take the studies at face value. Explain each component and give the range.

rows.label: Share of the outcome that wouldn't have happened anyway
rows.explainer: TEMPLATE: the share of the outcome that would not have happened without the program (other providers, existing trends, government). Cite coverage data or trend data where possible.

rows.label: This charity's share of credit, when shared with others
rows.explainer: TEMPLATE: where other organisations contributed to the same outcome (co-funders, coalition campaigns, government delivery), the share credited to this charity. 1 when it delivers alone.

rows.label: Share of credit used
rows.explainer: The charity's share of the resources behind the outcome; it applies whichever way credit is shared.

rows.label: Delivery adjustment (fidelity, compliance, follow-through)
rows.explainer: TEMPLATE: the share of the reported reach that actually receives the intervention as studied: dose completion, coverage survey vs. reported, companies honouring pledges.

rows.label: Leverage and funging
rows.explainer: TEMPLATE: below 1 when other funders (governments, the Global Fund) would have paid for this work without the donation; above 1 when the donation pulls in other money. GiveWell's top charities typically sit at 0.85–0.95.

rows.label: All adjustments combined
rows.explainer: The product of the adjustments above.

rows.label: Benefits and costs not modelled, as a share of modelled value
rows.explainer: TEMPLATE: GiveWell-style supplementary adjustment: list each effect not modelled (morbidity, stillbirths, treatment costs averted, rebound effects) with its sign and size.

rows.label: Deaths averted
Value of a death averted (units of value)
rows.explainer: GiveWell's moral weights for the age mix of deaths averted, times your multiplier on the value of a life.

rows.label: Units of value from deaths averted
Units of value from illness averted
Units of value from later-life income
Total units of value
Units of value per dollar
Staff pay as a share of total cost
rows.explainer: TEMPLATE: salaries and benefits ÷ total expenses, from the statement of functional expenses (or Form 990 Part IX lines 5–9).

rows.label: Pay gap versus comparable for-profit jobs
rows.explainer: TEMPLATE: how much less staff earn than in comparable for-profit roles. Anchor on the sector defaults in scripts/link-resource-shares.py (SECTORS: delivery 10%, services 15%, media 20%, research 30%) or, for animal advocacy, the 35% the ACE models use.

rows.label: Salary forgone by staff (in-kind donation)
Share of the full cost paid by cash donations
